technique_name: Describe a new way to use artificial intelligence in the classroom.
description: A popular new way to use artificial intelligence in the classroom is with personalized learning. AI-driven platforms can be used to customize learning experiences by analyzing a student’s progress, determining their strengths and weaknesses, and providing tailored lessons and activities to help them reach their goals.
